metadata.title: When you get that ONE kill and instantly question your life choices in VALORANT
metadata.description:
Wait, did that just happen?
I wasn’t even trying and yet... boom!
VALORANT’s chaos strikes again.
Click if your luck’s better than your aim!

Tap if you ever got a kill when you clearly didn’t deserve it!

#valorant #funnyclips #luckygamer #gamingfails #shorts
